guesstimated.description:
If true then java memory allocation instrumentation agent https://github.com/google/allocation-instrumenter was not
active so numbers are best guesses.

If you are running server locally use `-M` option with `c3-server` to enable memory allocation instrumentation.

objs.description: Statistics for instances by type name or java class name. @see JvmProfileMemorySpec#group.

delta.description: Set to `true` if this profile was produced by #diff method.
